Full bodies and shoes visible, relaxed feet slightly bent for playful controlled descent, upright bodies, friendly looking toward each other. Characters occupy about y=190 to y=960, consistent head/body proportions with reference. Centre each character at the exact horizontal centre of their own cell. Painterly polished storybook 3D illustration matching reference. Keep faces, clothing, colors and identity. Remove elephant/invitation entirely. No scenery, no text, no shadows on floor, no border, no other objects, no person touching the other person. Genuine alpha transparency around both figures and silk.
